headline: Visayas Grid Faces Red Alert as Available Capacity Trails Peak Demand
seoTitle: Visayas Grid Red and Yellow Alerts August 28 | FMB News
seoDescription: NGCP placed the Visayas grid under red and yellow alerts on August 28 with 2,307 MW available against projected peak demand of 2,402 MW.
deck: Available capacity was estimated at 2,307 MW against projected peak demand of 2,402 MW, with major coal units unavailable and imports from Mindanao constrained.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines placed the Visayas grid under red and yellow alerts on Friday, August 28, as available generation remained insufficient during peak periods.
NGCP estimated available capacity at 2,307 megawatts against projected peak demand of 2,402 MW.

sections.heading: Alert schedule
paragraphs: The red alert was scheduled from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. Yellow alerts covered 2 p.m. to 5 p.m. and 8 p.m. to 10 p.m.

A yellow alert means the operating margin is insufficient to meet the grid's contingency requirement. A red alert means supply is insufficient to meet consumer demand and the grid's regulating requirement.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Major coal-fired units including Therma Visayas Inc. Units 1 and 2 and KEPCO SPC Power Corp. Unit 1 remained unavailable, while imports from the Mindanao grid were limited.
Same-day reporting said 10 plants were unavailable during August and 16 others were operating at reduced capacity, bringing total unavailable capacity to about 979.6 MW.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A red alert raises the risk of controlled interruptions but does not mean every customer will automatically lose power. Households and businesses should follow their distribution utility and NGCP for local advisories.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Alert windows can change as generating units return or trip and as demand shifts. Watch for revised NGCP notices and confirmation that unavailable units have returned to service.
